policy: Sixteen distinct retained ordinary residential street groups, exactly four source owners each. Full measured/fallback source walls, independent cardinal native geometry, source roofs, court voids and mapped doors remain. Opening proportions and restrained material tones are explicit local context estimates, not surveyed per-house paint or historical restoration.
